findings.problem: Subject is 57 characters (limit 50). It also uses hype ('amazing book today') and mild urgency.
findings.fix: Shorten to 50 characters or fewer and remove hype, e.g. 'Learn to manage one AI Worker well'.

findings.problem: Preview text claims a '100 % guarantee' and a vague unsupported benefit ('cleaner and lighter at work'). This breaks voice.md section 4.2 (no guaranteed results).
findings.fix: Replace with a plain, honest preview of 90 characters or fewer, e.g. 'A short look at how to assign, govern, and manage an AI Worker.'

findings.problem: Greeting is 'Hello reader,' and does not use {{first_name}}.
Claims a '100 % guarantee' that the reader will 'become an expert and earn more'. This breaks voice.md section 4.1 (no income outcomes) and 4.2 (no guaranteed results or expertise).
findings.fix: Remove both claims. Say plainly what the book teaches: how to assign, govern, and manage an AI Worker.

findings.problem: 'Don't get left behind' is a fear and pressure phrase (voice.md section 3). 'Only a few copies left!' is fake scarcity (section 4.6).
The '[Buy now](https://example.com/buy)' link is a second main link with the wrong address. The rules allow exactly one button link, to https://agentfactory2.panaversity.org/five-horizons.
findings.fix: Remove it. Keep one button link to the five-horizons address, with button text that is not 'Read the introduction'.

findings.problem: The 'Read more' button is the only valid main link, but it has no sign-off link after it. Two calls to action also appear together (voice.md section 5 allows one).
findings.fix: Keep one fitting button, e.g. 'See the five horizons'. Add the sign-off link 'Read the introduction' separately in the sign-off.

findings.problem: Sign-off is incomplete. It is missing the closing line 'Start with Horizon 1. Learn to manage one AI Worker well.' and the 'Read the introduction: https://agentfactory2.panaversity.org/five-horizons' line.
findings.fix: Use the full sign-off from voice.md section 5.

findings.problem: The required two-line plain-text footer is missing (waitlist line, {{company_address}}, {{unsubscribe_url}}).
findings.fix: Add after the sign-off: 'You're getting this because you joined the agentfactory2.panaversity.org waitlist.' then 'agentfactory2.panaversity.org, {{company_address}} · Unsubscribe: {{unsubscribe_url}}' on its own line.
